BRAND DESIGN PRINCIPLE · CONSISTENCY WITH CREATIVE VARIETY
“Keep yellow and green consistent as your brand identity. Introduce orange and red for festive campaigns and sales, purple or blue for special creative concepts, and cream or mint for softer backgrounds. This gives you variety without making your brand look inconsistent.”
Permanent Brand Anchor: Brand Green (#39823C) & Brand Gold (#F3CB2D / #F3CB2C)
Official Shubham K Mart Brand Identity Standard
Canonical Core: Grounded in Brand Green (#39823C) and Brand Gold (#F3CB2D / #F3CB2C), balanced by warm Cream (#FBFAF4) and clean White (#FFFFFF) surfaces with high-contrast Ink (#192C20) typography.
Campaign & Anchor Rule: Campaign, sale, and category colors belong on promotional canvases. Every creative must retain the official Shubham K Mart brand anchor (yellow logo on Brand Green or green logo on Brand Gold).
THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Brand identity anchor

Keep yellow (#F3CB2D / #F3CB2C) and green (#39823C) consistent as your core brand identity across every consumer touchpoint.

02

Campaign & promotional palette

Introduce Tangerine Orange (#FF941A) and Crimson Red (#E63946) for festive campaigns, clearance banners, and high-urgency promotional graphics.

03

Category & soft backgrounds

Use Soft Fresh Mint (#D9F7E5) or Golden Cream (#FFF7D6) for softer backgrounds in grocery, organic, wellness, and luxury presentation.

04

Modern digital accents

Introduce Digital Purple (#7C3AED) and Sky Blue (#38BDF8) for modern app graphics, tech accessories, digital payments, and youth-oriented creatives.

05

Banner gradients

Use purposeful two-stop linear gradients (Signature Brand, Festive Energy, Fresh Mint, Modern Digital, Golden Premium) while preserving high contrast and legible typography.

06

Brand anchor requirement

Every campaign creative, promotional banner, or category graphic must feature the official Shubham K Mart brand anchor with its designated background (yellow logo on Brand Green, or green logo on Brand Gold).
